messages.author: c1b5bd71f8b85084
messages.subject: Pairwise Procrustes Distance Matrix?
parts: Is there a way to export a pairwise Procrustes distance matrix for all specimens after GPA alignment? (similar to the "Between OTU Procrustes chord distances" matrix included in Morphologika results)

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Pairwise Procrustes Distance Matrix?
parts:
Natalie,

 

If Y is a 3D array containing your landmark coordinates, try:

 

as.matrix(dist(gpagen(Y)$coords))

 

Dean
